name: @blackbelt-technology/frontend-mockup-loop
description: Pi extension + skill for a ground→contract→mockup→test→fix→learn frontend design loop. Ships a live mockup server tool, a Playwright breakpoint-screenshot tool, and a design-contract scaffolder. Works in any React/Tailwind/shadcn project.
